dimensions.assessment: Affects Georgian government officials, political figures, and individuals engaged in corruption or undermining democracy who are subject to sanctions, as well as U.S. and Georgian diplomatic and civil society personnel.
dimensions.evidence: Any individual who, on or after January 1, 2014, has served as a member of the Parliament of the Government of Georgia

dimensions.assessment: Imposes severe direct effects on targeted individuals through visa revocations, ineligibility, and blocking of property and transactions, alongside major potential shifts in U.S. foreign and security assistance.
dimensions.evidence: block and prohibit all transactions in property and interests in property of the foreign person

dimensions.assessment: Does not specify direct new federal funding amounts, but requires executive branch reports, strategies, and potential reevaluations of existing foreign and security assistance levels for Georgia.
dimensions.evidence: an assessment whether Georgia should remain the second-highest recipient of United States funding in the Europe and Eurasia region

dimensions.assessment: Amends U.S. foreign policy posture toward Georgia, mandates multi-agency reports and strategies, suspends the U.S.-Georgia Strategic Partnership Commission, and establishes specific mandatory and discretionary sanction authorities.
dimensions.evidence: The President shall impose the sanctions described in subsection (d)(2) with respect to each foreign person

dimensions.assessment: Imposes various reporting requirements, strategy mandates, and sanction authorities that are subject to a general five-year sunset provision from the date of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: This Act shall cease to have any force or effect beginning on the date that is 5 years after the date of the enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Exact dollar amounts for reevaluated foreign and security assistance funds.
importance_detail.rationale: The MEGOBARI Act introduces significant reporting, strategy development, and visa/property-blocking sanctions targeted at certain individuals involved in undermining democracy in Georgia, alongside potential adjustments to bilateral assistance.
